title: grain/capability-base@v1: a Grain's declaration of one base capability it implements in trusted provider code: the most it can grant, what it materialises in a sandbox, and what it implies. The Grain writes it, generated from its providers, in its own root; it is the contract, published for Silo and for readers, and never the Grain's own source of truth (docs/grainfiles.md §6.8)

grain.description: The Grain whose implementation this declares

provider.description: The trusted code that implements the base, for audit

dimensions.description: The axes the base's authority is measured on, each with its maximum on this Grain and where a reducer on it can be enforced. A reducer naming a dimension that is not here, or asking for enforcement the dimension does not offer, is refused (§6.8)

maximum.description: set: a list of values or patterns ("*" for whatever the provider's own credential reaches); quantity: the upper bound; time: the latest end

required.description: If this dimension narrows to empty, the capability is empty and the request is refused

materialises.description: Everything the base puts in a sandbox. Nothing else reaches it

path.description: Relative to the sandbox's working root

secret.description: The secret slot whose material this file holds

implies.description: What using the base reaches, which the Grain's policy checks with the effective capability before anything is materialised. from: <dimension> means the narrowed values of that dimension

proxies.description: The Grain proxies a use passes through, where on: use reducers are checked and logged

approval.description: required: a human must approve each task's use (grain's escalated capabilities); local: only this Grain's owner may, before each run
